title: Phillyrin: A potential therapeutic agent for osteoarthritis via modulation of NF-kappaB and Nrf2 signaling pathways.
authors: Ma, Jiawei; Wang, Ze; Sun, Yun; Zheng, Rukang; Tan, Hongye; Zhang, Hanwen; Jin, Zebin; Wu, Yaosen; Sun, Zeming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究连翘苷通过NF-kappaB和Nrf2信号通路治疗骨关节炎，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is the predominant cause of disability among elderly people worldwide and is characterized by cartilage degeneration and excessive bone formation. Phillyrin, derived from forsythia, is a key extract renowned for its pronounced antibacterial and anti-inflammatory effects. Forsythia, deeply integrated into traditional Oriental medicine, has historically been utilized for its various pharmacological effects, including antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and hepato-protective properties. Nevertheless, the anti-inflammatory impact of phillyrin on the progression of osteoarthritis remains enigmatic. The objective of this research was to assess the anti-inflammatory and anti-aging properties of phillyrin in mouse chondrocytes induced by IL-1beta, as well as to elucidate the fundamental mechanisms underlying the phenomenon at play. Additionally, the investigation extends to observing the impact of phillyrin by establishing a murine osteoarthritic model. The ultimate goal was to identify phillyrin as a potential antiosteoarthritic agent. This investigation employs a multifaceted approach. Initially, key action targets of phillyrin, along with its probable action pathways, were identified by molecular docking and network pharmacological techniques. These findings were subsequently confirmed through both in vivo and in vitro studies. Network pharmacological analysis revealed NFE2L2 (NRF2), NFKB1, TLR4, and SERPING1 as pivotal candidate targets for the treatment of osteoarthritis with phillyrin. Molecular docking revealed hydrogen bond interactions between phillyrin and Arg415, Arg483, Ser508, and Asn387 on the Nrf2 receptor, while electrostatic interactions occurred with residues Arg415 and Arg380. Experiments conducted in vitro indicated that phillyrin preconditioning hindered the IL-1beta-induced expression of proinflammatory factors which included TNF-alpha, COX-2, IL-6, and iNOS. Furthermore, phillyrin counteracts the IL-1beta-induced degradation of aggrecan and collagen II within the extracellular matrix (ECM). This protective action is caused by the inhibition of the NF-kappaB pathway by phillyrin. Additionally, the mitigation of chondrocyte aging by phillyrin was observed. Our investigation revealed that phillyrin mitigates inflammation and counteracts cartilage degeneration in osteoarthritis (OA) patients by suppressing inflammation in chondrocytes and impeding aging through suppression of the NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是全球老年人残疾的主要原因，其特征为软骨退变和过度骨形成。连翘苷（Phillyrin）源自连翘，是一种关键提取物，以其显著的抗菌和抗炎作用而闻名。连翘深深融入传统东方医学，历史上因其多种药理作用而被使用，包括抗菌、抗炎和保肝特性。然而，连翘苷对骨关节炎进展的抗炎作用仍不明确。本研究旨在评估连翘苷对IL-1β诱导的小鼠软骨细胞中的抗炎和抗衰老特性，并阐明其潜在的基本机制。此外，研究还通过建立小鼠骨关节炎模型来观察连翘苷的影响。最终目标是确定连翘苷作为一种潜在的抗骨关节炎药物。本研究采用多方面方法。首先，通过分子对接和网络药理学技术识别连翘苷的关键作用靶点及其可能的通路。这些发现随后通过体内和体外研究得到证实。网络药理学分析揭示NFE2L2（NRF2）、NFKB1、TLR4和SERPING1为连翘苷治疗骨关节炎的关键候选靶点。分子对接显示连翘苷与Nrf2受体上的Arg415、Arg483、Ser508和Asn387形成氢键相互作用，而与残基Arg415和Arg380发生静电相互作用。体外实验表明，连翘苷预处理抑制了IL-1β诱导的促炎因子表达，包括TNF-α、COX-2、IL-6和iNOS。此外，连翘苷对抗IL-1β诱导的细胞外基质（ECM）中聚集蛋白聚糖和II型胶原的降解。这种保护作用由连翘苷抑制NF-κB通路引起。另外，观察到连翘苷缓解软骨细胞衰老。我们的研究揭示，连翘苷通过抑制NF-κB通路，抑制软骨细胞炎症并阻碍衰老，从而减轻骨关节炎（OA）患者的炎症并对抗软骨退变。
